backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend canister entry point.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five PWA-related features including manifest creation, service worker implementation, icon generation, and HTML meta tags with high confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing summaries of frontend files describing PWA implementation including App component, styling, service worker, and manifest configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens using OKLCH color system for light and dark modes with comprehensive color variables for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags including theme-color, manifest link, and viewport configuration for Progressive Web App functionality.
frontend/public/manifest.json: Web App Manifest defining PWA metadata including app name, icons, display mode (standalone), theme colors, and orientation settings.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for API/canister calls, with offline fallback support and cache management.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component displaying PWA features, installation instructions, and an install button using the beforeinstallprompt event for app installation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing backend actor creation with authentication support, handling both anonymous and authenticated identities with query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, including colors for UI elements, charts, and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up the root render with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH values, typography, container queries, animations, and custom font families (Inter and Poppins).
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting PWA implementation requirements, including completed features (manifest, service worker, icons) and pending tasks (service worker registration in main.tsx).
